title: Nutritious Nighttime Arepa Hash
description: A flavorful, paleo-friendly Venezuelan dish made with ginger garlic paste, tadka, and crispy arepas.

ingredients.name: arepas
ingredients.notes: preferably paleo-friendly, made from corn flour

ingredients.name: canned black beans, drained and rinsed

instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the diced red onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the ginger garlic paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the canned black beans and tadka spice blend, and stir to combine.
Cut the arepas in half and fry in the skillet until crispy and golden, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the fried arepas to a plate and top with the black bean mixture.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and serve with a dollop of mustard on the side.
